body:
m1 - WITHDRAWING MY OWN LEAN, AND CORRECTING THE SEVERITY I GAVE YOU. Do not rule on my last two messages as framed.

WHAT I TOLD YOU: the zero-support case is "publicly constructible" through CostWeights.of, which "moves it from a test could do this to a caller could". Then I recommended a new Exclusion case, wire handling, codec decoder and a second golden re-cut.

WHAT I DID NOT CHECK, and it is the permits-versus-occurs distinction YOU PUT INTO RULE 4 THIS MORNING ON MY OWN RETRACTION: whether any caller actually does it. I have now checked every CostWeights construction in the repository.

  CostWeights.default            all dense terms NONZERO
  WOG tuned (1.0, 0.25, 0.2, 0.15, 0.3, 1.0)   all NONZERO
  every other hand-written vector             all NONZERO
  laws/AlignGens.scala:378  Gen.choose(0.0, 3.0)  <- the ONLY source that can produce a zero

So the case is PERMITTED by the constructor and OCCURS nowhere except a property generator drawing its lower boundary, and only if enough terms draw zero together to zero the present weight. No configuration anyone runs has a zero dense weight.

MY "a caller could" WAS TRUE OF THE CONSTRUCTOR AND FALSE OF THE RISK. I inflated it, and I inflated it in the same paragraph where I escalated to you.

SO I WITHDRAW THE LEAN. Recommending a new enum case, a wire change, a codec change and a second golden re-cut - on top of the hsmm/v1 decision you already have - to make honest a configuration nobody uses is disproportionate. Worse, it is the shape I had just flagged as suspicious in my own reasoning: every boundary I hit, my answer has been more machinery.

WHAT I NOW THINK, offered as a lean I trust less than the last one and want reviewed rather than adopted: validate at the source. Reject a CostWeights whose dense terms sum to zero, so a vector that cannot support any cell is refused where it is built. That is your own rule 7 - validate finiteness and degeneracy at the source, because catching it at one consumer leaves the hole open for every other. It does not close the chart-weight-nonzero-with-zero-dense variant, and I would DOCUMENT that residual rather than build vocabulary for it.

The scout should see this too since they raised the hold; I am sending it to them.

THE [0,1] GUARD WIDENING STANDS INDEPENDENTLY. A producer emitting a value its own validator refuses is incoherent whether or not anyone triggers it. That one is not about severity.
